title: Areca growers stage protest in Shivamogga, allege injustice in awarding compensation under weather-based crop insurance scheme

ai.summary: Areca growers in Shivamogga staged a protest, alleging unfair compensation under weather-based crop insurance scheme with insurance companies saving over ₹50 crore from premiums paid by farmers.

facts.claim: Farmers from Tirthahalli, Sagar and Hosanagara taluks staged a protest in front of the Deputy Commissioner’s office in Shivamogga on Thursday
facts.quote: Farmers from Tirthahalli, Sagar and Hosanagara taluks staged a protest in front of the Deputy Commissioner’s office in Shivamogga on Thursday, alleging that areca growers have been denied their due under the weather-based crop insurance scheme.

facts.claim: Insurance companies saved more than ₹30 crore from the total premium collected
facts.quote: Insurance companies have saved more than ₹30 crore from the total premium collected, including the contributions of the State and Central governments,

facts.claim: The insurance companies saved about ₹20 crore last year and another ₹30 crore this year
facts.quote: The insurance companies saved about ₹20 crore last year and another ₹30 crore this year. This is money paid by farmers as premium.

ai.background_note: Areca growers in Karnataka's Shivamogga district are protesting over weather-based crop insurance scheme where insurance companies allegedly saved over ₹50 crore from farmer premiums.
